description: Request an exact ERC-20 USDC funding transaction on the stored task network to the separate Speedbot task wallet. Does not spend. Wait until send_after_unix_seconds before authorizing the transfer; it must be mined after after_block. Early transfers require separately verified recovery, never another blind payment.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.

network.description: New tasks select an available network. Deposits, reviews, payouts and refunds retain the original task network.
